subject: HIPI status: goal-reaching repro done, linear-reward inference is the risk
body:
Ulla, Bruno,

Status through week 7. Goal-reaching repro is done: inverse-RL relabeling hits 71% success at 1M steps vs. 58% for the goal-relabeling baseline on our hardest reaching task, matching the published direction. Discrete-reward-set domains are running now; Tereza has 6 of 9 configs finished and the acceleration effect is visible in 5.

The risk is the linear reward family. Inferring the hindsight task there means normalizing over the reward-parameter space, and our current estimator needs roughly 3x the samples we budgeted to stay stable. Nikhil is testing a cheaper approximation; if it's not converged by April 10 we should consider demoing discrete rewards only and keeping linear as a stretch.

Compute is fine - titan-a100 best-effort has been giving us ~70 GPUs.

Maren
